metadata.calibration_basis: mixed upstream models and explicit assumptions; not target 7 nm calibration

license_notes.accelergy: MIT upstream framework; custom local estimator remains part of the project
license_notes.cacti: HP Software License Agreement notices; preserve source notices

limitations: ERT is a true Accelergy 0.4 output from the pinned upstream source and local primitive estimator; it is not a target PDK characterization.
PE, Vec, control, D2D PHY, DRAM IO, idle/leakage assumptions originate in the existing local runtime config and are explicitly marked assumed.
SRAM uses a 22 nm ITRS-HP CACTI 7 64 KiB/1024-bit macro; per-byte conversion linearizes one full 128-byte word and does not model partial-word fixed access cost.

HBM2 and DDR4 action energy uses DRAMSim3 ACT+READ/WRITE command energy per target byte. REF command energy and rank standby/background are reported in replay evidence but excluded from per-byte actions; configured hbm_idle/dram_background remains the sole background owner.
NoC action energy uses BookSim router input-buffer/switch/output dynamic components only; BookSim channel, clock and leakage totals are excluded. D2D PHY remains a separate configured assumption.
The direction-neutral HBM/DRAM runtime action uses an explicit 50/50 read/write byte mixture; direction-specific ERT entries and 20/80, 80/20 sensitivity values are also preserved.

CACTI leakage is per macro and the runtime lookup multiplies by the exact 1024 macros per configured 64 MiB die. DRAM background and DRAM cell energy remain outside the wafer heat grid; dram_io is on-wafer and mapped to the current router/IO thermal lump.
No 7 nm calibration, target D2D PHY, foundry SRAM compiler, or temperature-scaled PE/Vec/HBM/NoC action surface is available in these inputs.
model_mismatches: BookSim router dynamic energy uses its bundled 2007 32 nm high-performance power model.
SRAM uses the pinned CACTI 7 ITRS-HP 22 nm macro model, not a target foundry SRAM compiler.
Configured HBM/DDR capacity budgets differ from DRAMSim3 channel organizations; strict consumers must explicitly accept the organization sensitivity.
PE, Vec, control, D2D PHY, DRAM IO and multiple background coefficients are assumptions from the supplied run config, not measured target actions.
